document:7:395:0.text:
Cut the extracted memory into <style="highlight">Memory Fragments</style>. (I won't be detailing the tedious extraction procedure.)
Activate the device. Then, inject the fragments into <style="highlight">star crystals</style> and seal them with <style="highlight">chronostatin</style>.

Reminder: Under no circumstances should the star crystals be reshaped. "Memory Stars" just sounds much cooler than "Memory Jars"!
document:7:395:0.source_cn:
将提取出的记忆切割为<style="highlight">记忆碎片</style>（提取记忆的方法好麻烦，我懒得再写一遍了）。
启动仪器，将碎片注入准备好的<style="highlight">星之结晶</style>，并使用<style="highlight">时凝液</style>封存。
P.S. 决不能将星之结晶改变成其他造型，什么记忆瓶记忆罐的都不行。毕竟“回忆的星星”可比“回忆的瓶子”好听多了！
